description: Release state follows the Change in the Release parent field only. Re-read this table when that Change's state or approval changes, including when it moves backwards. No parent → Draft and stay there.

link.note: Only the Change number (or sys_id) on rm_release.parent is used. Other links are ignored. Empty parent keeps the Release in Draft.

testCases: Release with no parent number → Draft (and only Draft)
Parent cleared after the Release had moved on → Draft
Only the Change in Release.parent is used; other Change links are ignored
New → Draft
Assess → Draft
Authorize with approval requested / not requested / rejected / blank → Awaiting Approval
Approval state (same as Authorize, still waiting) → Awaiting Approval
Authorize after the Change is approved → Approved
Approval state after the Change is approved → Approved
Scheduled → Scheduled
Implement → Implementation
Review → Review
Closed → Closed Complete
Canceled (or Cancelled spelling) → Cancelled
ServiceNow numeric values (-5 New, -3 Authorize, …) resolve the same as labels
Forward path: New → Assess → Authorize (pending) → Authorize (approved) → Scheduled → Implement → Review → Closed
Backward path: Scheduled → Authorize (pending) moves Release Scheduled → Awaiting Approval
Backward path: Authorize → Assess moves Release → Draft
Canceled from any point moves Release to Cancelled
Unknown Change state leaves the Release where it is
No write when the Release is already on the mapped state
